statements.t: We look forward to presenting preliminary results from the first two FGR cohorts at our November 24 key opinion leader (KOL) event and to the ReMEDy2 interim analysis expected in the first quarter of 2027."

In FGR, enrollment of the first two dose cohorts has now been completed, and we look forward to reviewing the preliminary safety and clinical findings with leading maternal-fetal medicine experts later this month.
The webcast will remain available for play back on the Company’s website, under investor relations - events and presentations , following the earnings call and for 12 months thereafter.
A telephonic replay of the conference call will be available until November 19, 2026, by dialing (800) 770-2030 (US Toll Free) and entering the replay passcode: 7582187#.
